lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Wha--

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: What is this place?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Hello? Is someone there?

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Sam? Sam is that you?!

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: What are you doing here?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I don't know, I just...woke up here...

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I can barely remember anything it's all fuzzy

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Hang on I'll get you out just...let m-

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: -You can't, I've already tried, every door back here is busted

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: The only possible exit I've found was a door the leads to someplace called S5 but it's a dead end too,something might be blocking it from the other side

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Wait...if it's blocked from the other side maybe I can find it and unblock it

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: I'm in S4 right now, there has to be a way to S5 from here

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: I might've found something. hold on

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Okay, there's an elevator that goes down to S5, but it needs a key to use it

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Think you could find one?

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Ill try, but where on earth will I get one?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Maybe a manger's office or something? they're bound to have high enough clearance for something like that

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Let me see...

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Got it! There's a manger's office close by

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Hang in there Sam, I'm coming

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Wait! Before you go

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Be careful Christian, I keep hearing...things

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I don't think we're alone here, please be careful

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: You too, I-I'll be there as soon as I can, I promise

ALERT! ALERT!
INTRUDER SPOTTED IN S4, INITIATING LOCKDOWN PROTOCOLS
ALL PERSONNEL ARE TO FIND AND CAPTURE THE INTRUDER

THERE IS NOTHING FOR YOU HERE.
SURRENDER NOW AND MAKE YOUR DEATH QUICK.

lines.speaker: Creature
lines.text: Find...the intruder

lines.speaker: Creature
lines.text:
Bring...the intruder to...The Protector
Can't...reach...her

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Christian? Are you there?

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text:
I'm here, what's going on?
Are you okay?

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I should be asking you! What's happening over there?!

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text:
I-I don't know! I think I might've tripped or alerted this place's security system, and there was this thing talking about taking me to The Protector
Whatever that means

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: I don't know what's going on...

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Breathe Christian, you have to pull yourself together otherwise neither of us is getting out of here alive

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: I know...I know

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Did you find anything on how to lift the lockdown?

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Yeah, there are three override switches that need to be pulled

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Okay, good, while you do that I'll look for anything that can help us get out of here, maybe something about this Protector guy

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: I'll keep an eye out as well

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Any luck?

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Yeah, I found two switches so far

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text:
Good, we're gonna get out of here Christian, just one more switch to go
You can do this

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Why do you think we're here?

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text:
Do you think we're being punished for something?
Were we chosen at random? Is this some experiment by those Pangea people?

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text:
The last thing I remember was that I was walking, I think I was going somewhere...then suddenly...I'm here
fighting for my life against things things  I didn't even know could exist, being watched by someone, I just-

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Maybe...we're here for a reason, we couldn't have been chosen at random, we must have some purpose in whatever is going here.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: But no matter the reason, we will get ouf of here Christian, you and me, and I just know that you have what it takes to fulfil out purpose here.

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: I hope so.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Christian?! Christian! What's going on over there?!

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: I don't know! I pulled the last switch and the door just closed out of nowhere.

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: Crap, he's got us cornered, hold on Christian I'll see what I can do from here

lines.speaker: Sam
lines.text: I can't open it from here, but the door in front of you should take you directly to the manager's office, then you can leave through the door in his office.
I have to say, I'm quite impressed you made it this far, you've certainly lasted longer than most of the others.
Consider this a final test for you, should you survive, I'll be waiting for you, good luck.

Cecilia really has outdone herself hasn't she?
Well go on then, don't keep me waiting.

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: Sam? Sam, are you there?

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: If you can hear me, I got the elevator key, go to the door you told me about. I'll find it and meet you there.

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: O-Okay, I'm gonna head down now, I-I'll see you soon.

lines.speaker: The Protector
lines.text: There you are!

lines.speaker: The Protector
lines.text: Such a shame Cecilia wasted your potential on more of her nonsense.

lines.speaker: The Protector
lines.text: Guess we'll have to knock some more sense into her after we're done with you

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: What the hell big fella

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: W-where am I?

lines.speaker: Christian
lines.text: What is this place?
